paragraphs: The G500 has been part of the G-Class range since the 1990s, and across its generations has used three different V8 engines - from the earlier M113 through the M273 and into today's M176. The full breakdown by engine code is below.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every G500 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the G500 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the G500 spans three distinct V8 engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement - or assuming an M113 part will work on an M176 car - risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (M113, M273, or M176) via registration or VIN - Your generation (pre-2018 W463 or W463a) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
